title: Is combat running
sub: The “whether combat is running” condition in “Strike”: spend actions only in combat, and refuse in combat with no actions left.
start: there is an empty “Strike” effect granted to every sheet and an “Actions left” field on the sheet.

inCombat.title: Only in combat
inCombat.sum: “Strike” takes 1 off “Actions left” only while combat is running. No errors.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You taught “Strike” to refuse in combat with no actions left, without hints.

if.lead: The desk knows whether combat is running: it starts when the game master starts the turns. You can ask about it in a condition. Let “Strike” spend “Actions left” only in combat, and cost nothing outside it.
if.say: In “Strike” add an “If” block with the condition “whether combat is running”.
if.hint: The condition reads in words: “whether combat is running” is a suggestion that appears once you start typing “whether”.
if.type: Click the “If” condition and start typing “whether”.
if.pick: Choose “whether combat is running” in the list.
if.result: The “If” block with “whether combat is running” is in place.

spend.say: Inside the block make a change: “Actions left” minus 1.
spend.hint: “Whose” should say “Who acts” and “How” should say “subtract”: that is how they already are.
spend.addStep: In the branch of the block choose “change” in the “+ step” list.
spend.trap: “Change” stands outside the “If” block — actions will be spent outside combat too. Move it inside.

problems.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There should be no errors.

refuse.lead: The last task comes without hints.
refuse.goal: “Strike” has a “Stop” that fires only when combat is running and “Actions left” is below 1; “Problems” shows no errors.
refuse.say: Make “Strike” refuse (“Stop”) when combat is running and “Actions left” is below 1.
refuse.hint: The refusal must come before the action is spent. You can build it as one condition with “and”, or nest a second “If”.
refuse.result: In combat with no actions left “Strike” refuses.
